categories.main_business_segments: China National Nuclear Power Co., Ltd. (CNNP) primarily operates in nuclear power generation, including ownership and operation of nuclear power plants. It also develops and operates non-nuclear clean energy projects such as wind and solar power, and provides nuclear technology services and consulting. The company is engaged in power generation, transmission, and sales, as well as investment and management of clean energy projects and related technical services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced nuclear reactor technologies including self-developed third-generation pressurized water reactor technology 'Hualong One', and other reactor types such as CP300, CP600, CP1000, VVER-1000/1200, AP1000, CAP1000, and CANDU-6. It emphasizes safety design combining active and passive safety features, digital transformation in nuclear power operations, and innovation in nuclear fuel cycle and isotope production. Manufacturing and construction of nuclear power plants follow stringent quality and safety standards with integrated project management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: CNNP's primary customers are regional and national power grid companies in China, including State Grid Corporation and provincial grid companies. The company serves the electricity market across multiple provinces in China, providing nuclear-generated electricity and renewable energy. It also serves government and industrial clients through nuclear technology services and consulting. The company is expanding into overseas markets aligned with the Belt and Road Initiative.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with nuclear power plants and renewable energy projects distributed across more than 20 provinces including Zhejiang, Jiangsu, Fujian, Hainan, Liaoning, and others. It also has overseas investments and subsidiaries, including in the UK and Kazakhstan. The company’s headquarters is in Beijing, and it has a broad presence in eastern, northern, southern, central, southwestern, and northwestern China.
categories.supply_chain_position: CNNP operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the nuclear power supply chain, focusing on nuclear power plant construction, operation, and electricity sales. It also engages in upstream activities such as nuclear fuel procurement and isotope production through subsidiaries and joint ventures. The company integrates project development, construction, operation, and technical services, positioning itself as a comprehensive clean energy producer and service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes nuclear safety, high-quality growth, and digital transformation. It focuses on R&D in nuclear reactor technology, fuel cycle innovation, digital operation platforms, and nuclear multi-purpose utilization. Strategic emerging industries such as perovskite solar cells, medical isotopes, and fusion energy are also key R&D areas. CNNP emphasizes collaborative innovation with universities and research institutes and aims to enhance core competencies through technology breakthroughs and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: CNNP generates revenue mainly through electricity sales from nuclear and renewable energy power plants to grid companies. Additional revenue streams include nuclear technology services, consulting, and technical support. The company also earns income from investments in joint ventures and subsidiaries, as well as government subsidies and green financing instruments. Electricity sales are typically settled monthly with grid companies based on contracted prices.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: CNNP is a leading nuclear power operator in China, holding a significant market share with 25 operational nuclear units and numerous units under construction or approved. It competes with other major Chinese nuclear power companies and renewable energy producers. The company is recognized for its advanced reactor technologies and operational safety performance, maintaining a leading position in the domestic nuclear power industry and expanding its footprint internationally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, CNNP reported total assets of approximately RMB 660 billion and operating revenue of RMB 77.27 billion, reflecting steady growth. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 8.78 billion, with a net asset value exceeding RMB 110 billion. The company’s installed capacity includes 23.75 GW of nuclear power and nearly 30 GW of renewable energy. It has maintained a stable financial position with ongoing capital investments in new nuclear and renewable projects, supported by substantial financing activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: CNNP emphasizes nuclear safety as its core value proposition, delivering reliable, low-carbon, and clean energy. Its proprietary advanced nuclear technologies, such as Hualong One, provide competitive advantages in safety and efficiency. The company integrates digital technologies to optimize operations and maintenance, enhancing economic and environmental performance. Its diversified clean energy portfolio and strategic emerging industry investments position it as a comprehensive clean energy leader committed to sustainable development and energy security.
